title: PEEP trial: extrapulmonary ARDS, recruiter (R/I, decremental trial)
summary: A large recruitable population with a moderately stiff chest wall (Ecw 8). Run the R/I release (set PEEP 15 → 5) and the decremental PEEP trial from the monitor: the release expels far more than compliance predicts, the trial's compliance peaks well above the lowest PEEP, and the truth layer shows the recruited and tidally recruited volume.
objectives: Measure R/I with the one-breath PEEP release and read the pieces: ΔVrelease, Crs,low, Vrec.
Run the decremental PEEP trial and find the best-compliance PEEP; compare with the non-recruiter scenario.
With the truth layer on, watch the recruited volume and the tidal-recruitment count change with PEEP.
